candidate.title: SELEX / SELEX-seq / HT-SELEX
candidate.scope: Grouped transcription-factor DNA-binding schematic in the middle row only. The matching Illumina collection heading and caption identify the drawn pD40htSELEX/14N/well route as HT-SELEX. The poster also calls this SELEX and groups SELEX-seq with it: retain all three targets, but do not treat them as interchangeable complete protocols. SELEX denotes the broad selection family here as illustrated by the cited Jolma implementation. SELEX-seq denotes the cited Slattery implementation; its distinct 16-base/EMSA input history is retained in a separate, primary-paper-supported recovered-DNA-to-readout interface. The left Transcription factor binding site and Target sequence icons describe the desired recognition sequence; no arrow depicts production of the random library from genomic target DNA. The ligand legend specifies library components, not a separately drawn assembly procedure. There are no drawn alternative branches, pooling operation, or return loop. Neighboring HTGTS and HiTS-FLIP rows are outside the assigned card.
